note: Adapted from Silvestri's 1914 original description (in Latin), original name Mimeutermes sorex sp. n.; includes the nymph, soldier and worker with measurements; type locality Mamou, French Guinea. The original measurements use a comma as the decimal separator, transcribed here as 3.6, 1.42 etc.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head slightly longer than wide, the middle of the frons broad and rather convex, passing gradually into the nasus, the nasus slightly narrowed near its tip; antennae 12-segmented, segment 2 2/5 longer than segment 3, segment 4 slightly longer than segment 3 and slightly shorter than segment 5. In the worker the outer tooth of the mandible is rather long, the key character separating this species from its close relatives.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Soldier: head yellow rusty, nasus becoming brick-red anteriorly, thorax pale ochre-white, abdomen straw-yellow, hazel-coloured from the intestinal contents. Head slightly longer than wide, the middle of the frons broad and rather convex, passing gradually into the nasus; nasus slightly narrowed near its tip. Antennae 12-segmented, segment 2 2/5 longer than segment 3, segment 4 slightly longer than segment 3 and slightly shorter than segment 5. Anterior lobe of pronotum slightly concave in the middle of the anterior margin. Fore legs similar to those of the worker (outer tibial spines sometimes indistinct or absent). Abdominal tergites and sternites with very short but rather numerous hairs and a few short apical hairs. Measurements: body length 3.6 mm; head length 1.42 mm; head width 0.78 mm; nasus length 0.85 mm; antennal length 1.30 mm; hind tibia length 0.65 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Worker: body straw-yellow, head ochre, abdomen greyish from the intestinal contents. Antennal segment 3 slightly longer than segment 4, segment 5 slightly longer than segment 4; outer tooth of the mandible rather long. Anterior lobe of pronotum not or scarcely concave in the middle of the anterior margin. Abdomen similar to that of the soldier. Measurements: body length 4 mm; head length 0.72—0.85 mm; head width 0.85—0.90 mm; antennal length 1.10 mm; hind tibia length 0.54 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Nymph: body pale ochre-white, eyes black; head shape similar to the nymph of M. giffardii, antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 short and not well separated from segment 4; body length 6 mm, wing buds 1 mm long. Locality: Mamou, French Guinea; the nest lies about 10 cm deep in humus at the base of a tree trunk.
